bt.title: BT downloads
bt.description: Manage transfers from manual additions, platform downloads and workflows. Finished files stay in their output directory.
bt.settings.title: BT settings
bt.settings.proxy.label: BT proxy
bt.settings.proxy.direct: Do not use a proxy (ignore system proxy)
bt.settings.proxy.description: Applies only to BT downloads and defaults to no proxy. System proxy follows the machine running the server; saved HTTP or SOCKS5 proxies are also supported. Proxy failures never fall back to a direct connection.
bt.settings.proxy.unavailableDescription: Choose an available HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy, the system proxy, or no proxy before starting a new download.
bt.settings.proxy.udpDisabled: Proxy mode disables DHT, UDP trackers, local peer discovery and incoming connections. Downloads need peers from HTTP(S) trackers or peer exchange.
bt.settings.concurrency.label: Maximum concurrent BT downloads
bt.settings.concurrency.description: Additional transfers wait in the BT queue, independently of website request limits.
bt.settings.nextDownloads: Network changes apply when a transfer starts or resumes. Stop and resume an active transfer to use the new settings.
bt.add.title: Add BT download
bt.add.name: Name (optional)
bt.add.directoryDescription: Choose a directory on this server. Transfers use the BT network settings shown on this page.
bt.error.action: Could not update the BT download. Please retry.
bt.error.load: Could not refresh BT downloads. Showing the last available state.
bt.empty: No matching BT downloads. Add a magnet link, a torrent URL or a torrent file to start.
bt.settings.proxy.unsupported: BT supports HTTP or SOCKS5 proxies. Enter authentication separately in the proxy configuration.
